title: Fix review.yml's midnight-crossover weekday bug silently skipping the self-improvement review lane
plan: capture trigger epoch before checkout; derive weekday from frozen epoch, not now() read after checkout
outcome: shipped: review.yml now stamps a pre-checkout trigger epoch and derives weekday from it, fixing the silent skip that left review_findings.json stuck at 2026-06-20 for ~9 weeks; verified by extracting+running the plan script standalone against the real 2026-08-05 23:58:44 UTC trigger (run=false under old logic, run=true under fixed logic). A second, deeper bug (opaque is_error near-instant Claude Action failure on days the day-check DOES pass) is diagnosed but not fixed -- queued in improvement_tasks.json for next fire / Eitan's attention.
